messages:
k8s-oncall: seeing a short burst of apiserver 503s in eu-west1 around 10:12 UTC, controller-manager started dropping lease renewals. Noticed when a batch of GPU attach jobs kicked off.

aisha: that timing matches the scheduled GPU reclaim job from batch-scheduler. did we increase burst capacity? :thinking_face:

liam: yep, we pushed a burst policy at 10:05 to pull spare GPUs for on-demand agents. could be conntrack / proxy saturation.

k8s-oncall: apiserver logs show repeated 503s and "dial tcp: i/o timeout" to etcd endpoints. small stack here:

```
I0310 10:12:34.123] http: proxy error: read udp 10.4.2.11:51423->10.2.1.8:2379: i/o timeout
E0310 10:12:34.124] apiserver: failed to list/watch: etcdserver: request timed out
```

eng-sre-bot: alert: apiserver_error_rate eu-west1 > 5% for 3m (runbook: controlplane-readpath).

nate: conntrack close-wait and SNAT port exhaustion spikes in nat logs at same time. looks like ephemeral port churn from our GPU attach controller.

liam: hmm GPU attach flow spikes multi-az controlplane connections because attach-proxy talks to controller-provisioner then calls kube-apiserver repeatedly for status. each attach spawns short-lived clients -> conntrack pressure.

aisha: quick mitigation: throttle attach-controller concurrency to 10 and pause new preemptible allocations. can someone flip that?

liam: i'll patch the controller CRD quick: set .spec.attachConcurrency=10. applying now.

```
kubectl -n infra patch deploy gpu-attach-controller -p '{"spec": {"replicas": 1}}'
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/gpu-attach-controller ATTACH_CONCURRENCY=10
```

k8s-oncall: applied. also flipped the cloud autoscaler burst flag to off for eu-west1.

(30s pass)

nate: conntrack entries dropped by 70%, SNAT ports reclaimed. apiserver 503s dropping to ~0.6%. logs show fewer dial timeouts.

eng-sre-bot: incident note: partial mitigation success; follow-up required for permanent fix.

liam: root cause hypothesis: attach-controller parallelism + short TCP lifetimes -> conntrack table thrash -> kube-proxy / apiserver client dials hit ephemeral port reuse -> sockets stuck in TIME_WAIT/FIN_WAIT2 on nodes and SNAT pool depleted.

sre-leads: longer term: 1) add client-side keepalive pooling in attach-controller 2) instrument attach flow to reuse HTTP2 / keep connections to apiserver 3) request cloud SNAT capacity bump for eu-west1 4) add circuit-breaker in attach path to back off when apiserver error rate rises.

aisha: also add a controller-manager lease renewal backoff so leader election doesn't thrash under short readpath regressions.

k8s-oncall: opening follow-up tickets:
- SRE-3481: pooling+keepalive for gpu-attach-controller
- SRE-3482: circuit-breaker + backoff in attach flow
- SRE-3483: request SNAT increase with cloud infra for eu-west1
- SRE-3484: controller-manager lease backoff change

liam: will own SRE-3481 and SRE-3482. aisha take SRE-3484?

aisha: taking SRE-3484.

sre-leads: schedule postmortem if reoccurs or if error rate > 3% for > 10m. add cost/throughput analysis for the burst policy; we may be paying a lot to reattach vs queueing.

k8s-oncall: leaving watch for next 30m, markers in dashboards set. thanks all. :thumbsup:
